Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history

Class VisualizationLayout

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history.VisualizationLayout
@Component public class VisualizationLayout extends Object
Provides matrix operations for arranging images in column-based layouts.

This utility class handles the complex task of organizing multiple OpenCV Mat images into structured column layouts. It supports both single-column and multi-column arrangements with configurable spacing, making it essential for creating organized visual reports and sidebars in the Brobot history visualization system.

Key features:

  • Multi-column layout generation from lists of images
  • Configurable spacing between entries
  • Automatic distribution of images across columns
  • Support for both vertical and horizontal merging
  • Flexible column extraction for partial layouts

Layout structure: 

 Column 1    Column 2    Column 3
 +-----+     +-----+     +-----+
 | Img1|     | Img4|     | Img7|
 +-----+     +-----+     +-----+
   |||         |||         |||
 +-----+     +-----+     +-----+
 | Img2|     | Img5|     | Img8|
 +-----+     +-----+     +-----+
   |||         |||         |||
 +-----+     +-----+     +-----+
 | Img3|     | Img6|     | Img9|
 +-----+     +-----+     +-----+

Common use cases:

  • Creating sidebar visualizations for match results
  • Organizing classification results in grid layouts
  • Building comparison views of multiple images
  • Generating thumbnail galleries for reports

  • Method Details

    • getColumnMat

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getColumnMat(List<org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat> imagesMats, int matchesPerColumn, int columns, int spacesBetweenEntries)
      Creates a multi-column layout matrix from a list of images.

      This method organizes images into a grid layout with the specified number of columns and rows. Images are distributed column-by-column (top to bottom, then left to right). Each column is first created separately, then all columns are merged horizontally.

      Distribution example with 9 images, 3 columns, 3 per column:

      • Column 1: images 0, 1, 2
      • Column 2: images 3, 4, 5
      • Column 3: images 6, 7, 8
      Parameters:
      imagesMats - List of OpenCV Mat images to arrange. Can be any size.
      matchesPerColumn - Maximum number of images per column.
      columns - Number of columns in the final layout.
      spacesBetweenEntries - Pixel spacing between images (both horizontal and vertical).
      Returns:
      A single Mat containing all images arranged in the specified column layout.

    • mergeColumnMats

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat mergeColumnMats(List<org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat> columnMats, int spacesBetweenEntries)
      Merges multiple column matrices horizontally into a single matrix.

      This method takes pre-built column matrices and combines them side-by-side with the specified spacing. It's used both for final layout assembly and for merging individual columns.

      Parameters:
      columnMats - List of column matrices to merge horizontally.
      spacesBetweenEntries - Pixel spacing between columns.
      Returns:
      A single Mat with all columns merged horizontally.

    • getColumnEntries

      public List<org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat> getColumnEntries(List<org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat> entries, int column, int matchesPerColumn)
      Extracts entries for a specific column from the full list of images.

      This method calculates which images belong to the specified column based on the column index and matches per column. It handles cases where the last column may have fewer entries than the maximum.

      Index calculation: startIndex = column * matchesPerColumn

      Parameters:
      entries - Complete list of Mat images to distribute.
      column - Zero-based column index to extract.
      matchesPerColumn - Maximum number of images per column.
      Returns:
      List of Mat images belonging to the specified column.

    • getColumnMat

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getColumnMat(List<org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat> entries, int column, int matchesPerColumn)
      Creates a single column matrix from a subset of entries.

      This convenience method combines entry extraction and column building. It first extracts the appropriate entries for the specified column, then builds them into a vertical column layout.

      Parameters:
      entries - Complete list of Mat images.
      column - Zero-based column index to create.
      matchesPerColumn - Maximum number of images per column.
      Returns:
      A Mat containing the specified column with its entries.

    • getColumnMat

      public org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat getColumnMat(List<org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat> entriesInColumn)
      Creates a single column matrix from a list of images.

      This method arranges the provided images vertically with a fixed 4-pixel spacing between them. It's the core building block for creating column layouts, used by other methods to build individual columns before merging.

      Parameters:
      entriesInColumn - List of Mat images to arrange vertically.
      Returns:
      A Mat containing all images arranged in a single column.
